title: int:Order
description: A single buy (Bid) or sell (Offer) order submission to a market slot. Subclass of cim:MarketFactors.

orderId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:orderId. UUID v4.

marketId.description: FK to Market. IRI: int:marketId. UUID v4.

orderType.description: Buy or sell order. IRI: int:orderType.

orderStatus.description: Lifecycle status of this order submission. IRI: int:orderStatus.

timeSlot.description: Target delivery timeslot. IRI: int:timeSlot. ISO 8601 with timezone.

quantity.description: Energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:quantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

priceLimit.description: Price limit in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:priceLimit. Unit: EUR/kWh.

energySourcePreference.description: Preferred energy source types. IRI: int:energySourcePreference.

energyType.description: Energy type classification for this order. IRI: int:energyType.

createdBy.description: FK to Actor who submitted. IRI: int:createdby. UUID v4.

createdAt.description: Order creation datetime. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Order last updated datetime. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

cancellationReason.description: Human-readable cancellation reason. IRI: int:rejectionReason. Populated when orderStatus = Cancelled.

preferredTradingPartner.description: Preferred trading partner preferences. IRI: int:preferredTradingPartner.
